description: This Java class is a Spring Boot EnvironmentPostProcessor that maps environment variables like DATABASE_URL into Spring Boot's datasource properties, specifically for PostgreSQL databases. It normalizes various URL formats, ensures SSL mode configuration, and injects the parsed JDBC URL into the application's environment for database connectivity setup.

classes.name: DatabaseUrlEnvironmentPostProcessor
classes.description: A Spring Boot environment post-processor that reads database URL environment variables, normalizes and parses them into JDBC URLs, and overrides Spring Boot datasource properties to facilitate PostgreSQL database connectivity.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Defines the execution order of this post-processor, ensuring it runs early in the environment setup.

methods.name: postProcessEnvironment
methods.description: Main logic to override datasource environment variables based on environment variables like DATABASE_URL.

methods.name: firstNonBlank
methods.description: Returns the first non-blank string from the provided list of values.

methods.name: normalizeDatabaseUrl
methods.description: Sanitizes the raw database URL, removing 'psql' prefixes, flags, and quotes to produce a clean URL.

methods.name: parseToJdbc
methods.description: Parses a normalized database URL into a JDBC URL and extracts username and password if present.

methods.name: ensureSslMode
methods.description: Ensures that the JDBC URL has sslmode=require, appending it if missing.

methods.name: parseQuery
methods.description: Parses query parameters from a URL into a Map.

methods.name: urlEncode
methods.description: Encodes strings for URL query parameters.
